title: Add LRU eviction to the cache
body: Evicts the oldest entries when the cache grows past its capacity.

files.patch:
@@ -28,7 +28,15 @@ class Cache:
     def set(self, key, value):
         self._store[key] = value
         self._order.append(key)
-        return value
+        self._evict_if_needed()
+        return value
+
+    def _evict_if_needed(self):
+        # Remove oldest entries until we are within capacity.
+        while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
+            oldest = self._order[0]
+            del self._store[oldest]
+            # BUG: self._order is never trimmed, so index 0 keeps pointing at a
+            # key that was already deleted on the next iteration.
